name: HGH Fragment 176-191
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: HGH Fragment 176-191 (FR) is a structurally modified synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 6 pack sizes: 1 mg, 2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, 12 mg, 15 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is HGH Fragment 176-191 tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: HGH Fragment 176-191 is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the FR certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 221231-10-3, formula C80H127N23O24S2, 1859.1 Da).

faq.question: How should HGH Fragment 176-191 be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this FR preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for HGH Fragment 176-191?
faq.answer: HGH Fragment 176-191 is stocked in 6 pack sizes (1 mg, 2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, 12 mg, 15 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $35.52; 10–49 kits falls to $32.68 (−8%) and 50+ to $30.20 (−15%).
